description: Implementation of the Ambiorix class for platform-specific network API interactions, including data model loading, connection management, event handling, and parameter transactions within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: AmbiorixImpl
classes.description: Implements platform-specific network API interactions, including data model management, connection handling, event registration, and parameter transactions within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the bus connection, loads data model, sets up connection, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: load_datamodel
methods.description: Loads and parses the data model from the specified path, adding callbacks and functions.

methods.name: connect_and_register
methods.description: Establishes connections to URIs and registers the data model.

methods.name: init_event_loop
methods.description: Registers event handlers for the main file descriptors in the event loop.

methods.name: init_signal_loop
methods.description: Registers event handlers for signal file descriptors.

methods.name: remove_event_loop
methods.description: Removes event handlers for the main file descriptors.

methods.name: remove_signal_loop
methods.description: Removes event handlers for signal file descriptors.

methods.name: find_object
methods.description: Finds an object in the data model by relative path.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Adds a subobject (MIB) to a specified object.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Removes a subobject (MIB) from a specified object.

methods.name: prepare_transaction
methods.description: Prepares a transaction for modifying an object.

methods.name: apply_transaction
methods.description: Applies a prepared transaction.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the data model for various data types.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Reads a parameter value from the data model for various data types.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance of an object in the data model.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance of an object by index.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Retrieves the index of an object instance based on a key.

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Returns the current time in RFC 3339 format from the data model.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Sets the current time in the data model object.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets a specific timestamp in the data model object.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Removes all instances of a specified object.
